risk_title: Assistant gives wrong delivery or returns information
description: Answers may be out of date or invented, leading to customer complaints and refunds
treatment_actions: Ground answers on live policy pages; hand over to a person below a confidence threshold; weekly transcript sampling

risk_title: Customers are not told they are speaking to AI
description: Interface might not make clear that the assistant is automated
treatment_actions: Banner and first message identify the assistant as AI; test on mobile layouts

risk_title: Personal data in chats kept by the supplier for too long
description: Customers may type names addresses or order details that the supplier stores
treatment_actions: Agree a 30 day retention limit in the data processing agreement; mask account and card numbers before storage

risk_title: Supplier outage leaves customers without a route to support
description: Assistant is the first contact on the website and an outage could delay replies
treatment_actions: Add availability commitment and service credits to the contract; keep a human-only queue as fallback

description: Training data or scoring rules might lower scores for people with career breaks or other protected characteristics
treatment_actions: Obtain supplier bias testing; compare pilot outcomes by group; no automatic rejection

description: Recruiters might accept the ranking without real review
treatment_actions: Require a recorded reason when the ranking is followed or departed from; train recruiters on automation bias

risk_title: Supplier cannot supply the documentation a deployer needs
description: Instructions for use and logging details may be incomplete
treatment_actions: Request instructions and log details before the pilot ends; make renewal conditional on them

risk_title: Applicants are not told that AI supports the process
description: Applicants and interview panels may not know that a tool is used
treatment_actions: Add a notice to the careers page and application acknowledgement; brief interview panels

risk_title: Optional emotion analysis feature is switched on
description: The supplier offers a video interview feature that infers emotions, which is a banned practice in the workplace
treatment_actions: Switch the feature off in the contract and configuration; check at each release

risk_title: Forecast quality falls after a change in buying patterns
description: Model trained on past data may not reflect new ranges or seasonal changes
treatment_actions: Monthly accuracy report against actual sales; planner override; retrain when error passes the agreed limit

risk_title: Staff paste customer or commercial data into the assistant
description: Data might leave the organisation or be reused by the supplier
treatment_actions: Approve an enterprise workspace that does not train on inputs; block consumer accounts at the network; short training

description: Generated text may contain errors that staff do not notice
treatment_actions: Require human review before external use; add examples to the guidance

risk_title: Extraction error leads to a wrong supplier payment
description: A misread amount or bank detail could pass through
treatment_actions: Existing three-way match to purchase order and manual check of low-confidence fields are sufficient; keep monitoring

risk_title: Credit model refuses credit to sole traders unfairly
description: Model might use proxies that disadvantage some groups and the reasons may not be explainable
treatment_actions: Complete classification review and impact assessment before any pilot; keep the human decision; give reasons on request

risk_title: Model is treated as minimal risk when it may be high-risk
description: Annex III point 5(b) may cover creditworthiness of sole traders
treatment_actions: Obtain a written legal view; record the rationale in the inventory
